intro.h2: A Chico kitchen shop where you can see it all first
paragraphs: New Again Kitchen Remodeling makes kitchen remodeling in Chico simpler by keeping the choices in one place. The Mangrove Ave showroom has granite and quartz samples, full cabinet displays and tile, so you can see how the pieces of your new kitchen work together before you decide.

It is a smaller company, and the team says that lets the staff really get to know each client and what they need. Customers back that up: one called them easy to communicate with, personable and not pretentious, and said they got a great deal. Google's review summary also quotes a homeowner who noted that they showed up, finished, and the price remained what they were quoted.

about.text: New Again Kitchen Remodeling is a kitchen remodeler at 1108 Mangrove Ave in Chico, California. The showroom is set up like a row of finished kitchens, with navy shaker cabinets around a white farmhouse sink, cherry and honey-toned cabinet displays, and working sinks and appliances. The team describes itself as a smaller company where staff can really get to know clients and their needs, with a variety of granite and quartz, a range of cabinet styles and a tile selection. One customer calls the team personable, easy to communicate with and a great deal.

image.alt: New Again showroom on Mangrove Ave with navy shaker cabinets around a farmhouse sink and cherry cabinet displays

items.name: Courtney A.
items.text: It has been both a pleasure and so easy to work with New Again! We bought their Display cabinets and counters from their old show room and then paid them to install the counters. They were easy communicate with, personable and not pretentious. They gave us a great deal and our kitchen looks amazing!  I can’t recommend their team enough!

service_area.h2: Kitchen remodeling in Chico and nearby
service_area.text: New Again Kitchen Remodeling works from its showroom at 1108 Mangrove Ave in Chico, California, and installs kitchens for Chico homeowners. Come in to see granite, quartz, cabinets and tile in person, then the team measures and installs at your home. If you live outside Chico and want to know whether New Again can take on your kitchen, call (530) 899-2888.

items.q: Where is your showroom and when is it open?
items.a: The showroom is at 1108 Mangrove Ave, Chico, CA 95926. It is open Monday through Friday from 9 AM to 5 PM and Saturday from 9 AM to 3 PM, and closed Sunday. Saturday hours make it easy to come in and compare materials on a weekend.

items.q: What countertop materials do you carry?
items.a: New Again carries a variety of granite and quartz. Granite variety comes up in several Google reviews, and the stone on hand has included Glacier White, cream granites with gold veining and speckled white granites, so you can compare colors in person before you choose your counters.

Yes. The showroom displays several cabinet styles, including navy shaker, cherry and honey-toned raised panel, set up as full kitchen runs with sinks and appliances. One customer bought display cabinets and counters from the old showroom and had New Again install the counters.

items.q: Does the price stay what you quote?
items.a: Ask the team to walk you through exactly what your quote covers before work starts. Google's review summary quotes a homeowner saying they showed up, finished, and the price remained what they were quoted, and another reviewer said New Again gave them a great deal on their kitchen.

Call (530) 899-2888, email newagainkitchen@gmail.com or visit the Mangrove Ave showroom. Bring photos and rough measurements of your kitchen if you have them, so the team can help you choose cabinets, granite or quartz and tile and price the installation.

final_cta.text: Visit the Chico showroom on Mangrove Ave or call to talk it through.
